# Paul Nehme Tekle

> Software Engineer based in Paris, France. Full stack developer in alternance at Aether Financial Services from October 2026 (Angular, PHP CodeIgniter); previously Full Stack Team Lead at YOOVO in Beirut (2024–2026). Studying for a Master's in Web & Mobile Development at Éstiam. Looking for a full-time software engineering role in Paris once the alternance ends.

The website paulnehmetekle.com is an interactive portfolio styled as a retro desktop operating system ("PNT.OS"). This file is a plain-text summary of the same information.

## Experience

- **Full Stack Developer (Alternance), Aether Financial Services — Paris, from October 2026.** Aether Financial Services (https://aetherfs.com/) is an independent Paris-based financial services firm (private debt agency, valuation of financial instruments, corporate & issuer services). Full stack development with Angular and PHP CodeIgniter.
- **Full Stack Team Lead, YOOVO — Beirut, 2024–2026.** Led a full stack team (sprint planning, code reviews, quality assurance); drove architecture decisions; built features with Angular, React.js, C# .NET and MySQL; designed and deployed an Agentic AI system that automated development workflows and cut feature delivery time; CI/CD with Jenkins and AWS deployments.
- **Freelance Full Stack Developer — 2023–present.** Web and mobile applications built end-to-end for clients (Angular, React Native, Laravel, Django, FastAPI, Ionic). Notable projects:
  - **NutriClinic** (private client project): clinic management system for a nutrition clinic — clients, appointments, consultations, payments, staff, audit log. Next.js, TypeScript, REST API, zod, Prisma, PostgreSQL.
  - **WCN · Wheel In Crypto** (final year project, 2023–2024): cryptocurrency reward system for safe driving — Angular + .NET web, Angular Ionic + .NET mobile, Solidity smart contracts, GPS tracking with Google Maps.
